grades.main_gap: Core lemmas (finiteness of involved primes; essential primes are ubiquitous) and backward extension are explicitly unproved; only the conditional eventual-periodicity reduction is given.
grades.notes: Only Lemma 1 (trivial pigeonhole) is proved. Parts 3 and 6 are correct but conditional on the unproved finiteness lemma. Part 5's claim that minimal hitting sets contain all of E is false (contradicted by the write-up's own example). The hardest arguments are admitted gaps.
